definition: Trials records a selected Boolean action and its outcome at each episode. SuccessfulRecord reports success for selected actions before n. It says nothing about unselected actions, cross-time invariance, causal direction or identification. successful and failingAfter have the same successful record and different next selected outcomes.
note: Bounded analytical vocabulary for #269. This definition fixes test semantics; source endorsement or normative adequacy is not established by naming it.
